author: bardic-inspiration
name: Avalanche Ram
summary: A massive bighorn whose bellow and stamping hooves shake loose the slope above its enemies.
description: Avalanche rams clash on the high slopes in late autumn, and the crack of their horns can be heard for miles. Valley villages count the slides each season and blame the rams for every one.

traits.name: Charge
traits.text: If the ram moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra {dmg:2d6:bludgeoning} and, if it is Large or smaller, has the {ref:condition/prone} condition.

traits.name: Sure-Footed
traits.text: The ram has {ref:glossary/advantage} on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would move it or give it the {ref:condition/prone} condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The ram makes two Ram attacks.

actions.name: Rockslide Bellow
actions.onFailure: , and the target has the {ref:condition/prone} condition.
actions.onFailureOrSuccess: The ground in the Cone becomes {ref:glossary/difficult-terrain} until cleared.
